name: agent-changes-review
title: Reviewable changes
description: The fields an agent wants to change, each accepted or rejected before any is applied.

ReviewableChangesRoot.description: The state and the words for the parts inside; renders a `div`. Other props, `ref` included, go to it.

props.name: changes
props.description: The fields the agent wants to change, as AgentSuggestionChanges takes them; add an `id` to each to key `value` by it.

props.name: value
props.description: Each change's decision, by id (controlled). A change left out is pending.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The decisions to start from (uncontrolled). Everything is pending without it.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with every decision whenever one changes.

props.name: onApply
props.description: Apply: gets the accepted changes only, in their order, and every decision. Return a promise to hold the `applying` stage until it settles; if it rejects, review starts again.

props.name: status
props.description: Sets the stage yourself; without it, it follows `onApply`.

props.name: control
props.description: `buttons`: Accept and Dismiss on each card. `checkbox`: a Checkbox before each card's name, checked to accept.

ReviewableChangesList.description: The cards, one `role="group"` per change. Other props, `ref` included, go to its `div`.

ReviewableChangesAcceptAll.description: Accepts every change. Gone once they're applied. Its text is `acceptAll` from SatinLabels unless you pass children. Other props, `ref` included, go to the Button.

ReviewableChangesApply.description: Applies the accepted changes: "Apply 2 changes", or your children. Disabled while none is accepted, busy while `applying`; once `applied` it stays in place, says Applied and does nothing, so focus isn't lost. Other props, `ref` included, go to the Button.

ReviewableChanges.description: The cards, then Accept all and Apply on the right, 4px further down as in AgentSuggestion's actions row. Other props, `ref` included, go to the root `div`.
